verdict.rationale: The pack shows no documented public API: every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returned 404, and no REST or SDK reference appears. Trivy can still be driven programmatically through its documented CLI (e.g. `trivy image`, `trivy k8s`), which users call easy to automate, and through an official MCP server plugin, so it gets partial credit only. Missing for 10: a documented public HTTP/REST API or SDK, an OpenAPI spec, an API reference with auth and endpoints, and machine-readable docs (llms.txt and markdown docs also 404).
